headlines.title: Settler violence blocks West Bank homecoming
headlines.description: Settler violence blocked a Palestinian family from returning to their home on the West Bank. NBC News’ Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: Video shows Diddy’s life in prison
headlines.description: For the first time, footage exclusively obtained by NBC News shows Sean Combs using a cell phone which is prohibited by federal law. NBC News spoke to four men who spent time with Combs in prison. Multiple sources say he’s paid thousands of dollars a month to other inmates to do tasks for him. NBC News’ Chloe Melas has the story.

headlines.title: OpenAI launches always-on AI agents a day after apologizing for a hack by its bots
headlines.description: OpenAI announced its new AI agent product, Dots, amid a barrage of controversy over AI agents that had gone rogue.

headlines.title: Trump hosts tech leaders for meeting on A.I.
headlines.description: President Trump released an agreement signed by top tech leaders on increasing standards for A.I. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Supreme Court allows Trump’s ‘third country’ deportation policy
headlines.description: It’s the second time the court has rejected lower court rulings that immigrants must be able to object before being sent to countries to which they have no previous connection.

headlines.title: Pro-Trump TV ads paid for with Customs and Border Protection money, official says
headlines.description: The ads, which the White House has described as “public service announcements,” drew bipartisan criticism for being paid for with taxpayer money.

headlines.title: Trump’s border wall construction cut into an ancient ground carving older than Stonehenge
headlines.description: The Las Playas intaglio carving of a huge fish is at least two thousand years older than the first Egyptian pyramid, according to researchers’ recent estimations.

headlines.title: New questions emerge over 2024 investigation into alleged Cornell rape
headlines.description: An attorney for the female student who sued Cornell over an alleged sexual assault says campus police failed to follow up on key evidence. The university says campus police investigated and consulted with the DA’s office, which is “the established protocol.” NBC News’ Maggie Vespa reports.

headlines.title: Jack Smith testifies at Senate hearing, defending decision to charge Trump
headlines.description: Jack Smith appeared before the Senate Judiciary Committee amid the Justice Department’s push to target law enforcement officials involved with his investigation into President Trump. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports on how Smith responded to senators.

headlines.title: ‘A total dirtbag’: GOP senator mistakenly accuses Smith of perjury over NBA game
headlines.description: Former special counsel Jack Smith’s Senate Judiciary Committee hearing became tense after Sen. Eric Schmitt, R-Mo., presented a text message to Smith that he suggested showed he was in Atlanta for a basketball game in 2024. What unfolded was a heated exchange of conflicting information, which resulted in the discovery that Schmitt had confused the names of basketball teams.

headlines.title: Anger grows across Spain after elderly woman is evicted from her home of 70 years
headlines.description: An 87-year-old Spanish woman was forcibly evicted Wednesday from the Madrid apartment she had lived in for more than 70 years, in a case that highlights a growing housing crisis in the country.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.
